title: The pro-etale field site as profinite Galois sets
statement:
Let $k$ be a field, let $k^s/k$ be a separable closure [def-pd-separable-closure], put $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$ and $\bar s=\operatorname{Spec}k^s$, and let $G=\operatorname{Aut}_k(k^s)$ with the Krull topology (stabilizers of finite subextensions form an open neighborhood basis of $1$). Use small representatives and a coefficient universe containing them [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $\mathcal B_s$ be the full subcategory of quasi-compact quasi-separated objects of the small pro-etale site $s_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $\mathbf{Prof}_G$ be the category of compact Hausdorff totally disconnected spaces with continuous left $G$-action and continuous equivariant maps. Give it coverings the families having a finite jointly surjective subfamily.

There is an equivalence $\mathcal B_s\simeq\mathbf{Prof}_G$, carrying the induced pro-etale topology to this topology. The inclusion $\mathcal B_s\subset s_{\mathrm{proet}}$ is a dense subsite: every object has a covering by objects of $\mathcal B_s$, and its topology is the induced topology. Base change along $\bar s\to s$ corresponds to forgetting the $G$-action under the analogous equivalence $\mathcal B_{\bar s}\simeq\mathbf{Prof}$. For a profinite set $P$, write $T[P]=\varprojlim_i\coprod_{P_i}T$ for the test scheme of [lem-weil-pbc-profinite-test-object-functor]. Under the equivalence, $s[P]$ corresponds to $P$ with trivial action, while $\bar s[P]$, considered over $s$, corresponds to $G\times P$ with $G$ acting by left translation on the first factor. The identifications are natural in $P$ and take the morphism $\bar s[P]\to s[P]$ to $G\times P\to P$.
